title: A self-control share of screen time
hook: Two stated cases: explore the total time behind a stated attributable share.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the total time behind a stated attributable share affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Added, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the total time behind a stated attributable share in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
